moments.text: Infrared view with crosshair, 'N' marker and redaction boxes. A small bright blob with a dark rim drifts from left of the crosshair to above.
The background turns grainy and the blob slides to just right of the crosshair, where it stays, bobbing slightly.
A second, tiny bright spot crosses below the crosshair from left edge to right edge, behind the left redaction box, in about 0.8 s.
The picture flashes white, dark, then white; in the first white frame the blob shows as a short horizontal capsule outline right of centre.
In the washed-out view a small outlined oval moves right to left across the lower half, leaving past the left redaction box at 12.9 s.
Crosshair over plain grey with no object. The picture flashes white at 15 s, stays dark until 16.2 s, and washes out white 18.8–19.7 s.
